bio.markdown: I'm **Alberto Castro**, a front end engineer from Mexico now building software in the United States. I'm happily married and live with my two beautiful cats, who keep life interesting. I work across the stack and enjoy everything from clean UI to backend logic, infrastructure, and turning ideas into real products. This site is where I share the projects I care about and give people an easy way to connect with me, while offering a simple look at who I am and the work I like to create.

jobs.title: Front-End Engineer II
jobs.description: Modernized a decade-old logistics product, built large-scale infrastructure improvements, and led initiatives that transformed reliability, real-time UI, and developer experience across operational tools.

projects.name: CDN Decoupling & Deployment Infrastructure
projects.description: Separated frontend assets from backend builds and created a dedicated CDN using CloudFront, S3, and Route 53. Rewrote the deployment process using a new pipeline, reducing deploy and rollback times from over an hour to approximately four minutes. Added dashboards, metrics, and alarms to improve visibility and operational reliability.

projects.name: Legacy Modernization & Hybrid Architecture
projects.description: Led the migration of a 2008 jQuery UI application to React. Designed a hybrid architecture allowing both stacks to coexist during the transition. Implemented an interop communication layer, introduced TypeScript, and integrated the organization's design system.

projects.name: Developer Experience Overhaul
projects.description: Replaced the slow legacy build system with Webpack and hot module replacement, reducing the development feedback loop from 10 minutes to 5 seconds and drastically improving team productivity.

projects.name: Real-Time Load Decorations System
projects.description: Built a real-time event pipeline using AppSync to update rows in two different table systems (React and jQuery DataTables). Modeled messages, created a transformer layer, and implemented real-time decoration logic for operational insights.

projects.name: Validation Failure Interceptor
projects.description: Developed a global interceptor for handling structured validation failures returned from backend services. Dynamically rendered React or non-React components inside modal flows, collected user responses, and retried requests with updated payloads.

projects.name: Client-Side Dependency Aggregator
projects.description: Created a declarative API orchestrator using topological sorting to handle dependent network calls. Allowed developers to declare APIs, define dependencies, and automatically sequence execution with transformation support.

projects.name: CDN Dashboards & Observability
projects.description: Built dashboards, alarms, and metrics that exposed CDN performance, asset delivery health, and reliability trends after decoupling frontend from backend infrastructure.

projects.name: CloudWatch RUM Integration & Custom UX Metrics
projects.description: Integrated CloudWatch Real User Monitoring for usage insights, emitted custom events, and built UX latency metrics to measure client-side performance and user-perceived responsiveness.

projects.name: Operational Beta Testing Program
projects.description: Coordinated a beta tester group with fulfillment center associates to validate new workflows, gather operational feedback, and de-risk production releases.

projects.name: Sidelining Operations UI
projects.description: Built a small React-based interface used by operations staff to manage package sidelining workflows. Leveraged the team's modernized build system and deployment pipeline.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Joined one of Mexico's largest software consulting firms. Worked across Drupal, PHP, and frontend technologies. More details pending.

jobs.title: Indie Android Developer
jobs.description: Published first Android app, marking the start of personal mobile development interests.

projects.name: First Android App
projects.description: Personal Android app published on August 9, 2014. Details to be added once specified.

jobs.title: Lead Mobile Developer
jobs.description: Led development of a mobile app for El Valle de Guadalupe. Managed two developers, collaborated with designers, and shaped product direction. Built custom navigation framework for Cordova before modern systems existed.

projects.name: Guia del Valle (GuvApp)
projects.description: Mobile app for discovering places, wineries, restaurants, and activities in El Valle de Guadalupe. Included a full catalog system and custom navigation architecture.

jobs.title: Developer / Designer Support
jobs.description: Split time between two leaders: half focused on a PHP-based ads and promotions platform, and half handling rapid landing page development with vague requirements.

projects.name: Ads & Promotions Platform
projects.description: Maintained and added features to a PHP-MySQL promotional site used for marketing campaigns.

projects.name: Marketing Landing Pages
projects.description: Built multiple landing pages based on rough design direction and loose requirements. Handled layout, styling, and asset preparation.

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: Worked with a designer to turn static visual designs into real websites. Joined shortly after leaving Ingersoll Rand and took on custom website builds for small businesses.

jobs.title: Intern - Forecast & Materials Department
jobs.description: Built an internal inventory system using ASP.NET Web Forms. Gathered requirements from operations staff and developed a full stack tool for material tracking.

projects.name: Inventory Management System
projects.description: Internal system for tracking materials and forecasting needs. Designed UI, gathered requirements from operations, and implemented the full application.
